arguments.query: SELECT name,sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type="table"

SELECT json_object('bookings',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('booking_id',booking_id,'request_id',request_id,'flight_id',flight_id,'passenger_id',passenger_id,'amount',amount_cents,'status',status,'client_reference',client_reference)) FROM bookings),'charges',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('charge_id',charge_id,'booking_id',booking_id,'key',idempotency_key,'amount',amount_cents,'state',state,'created',created_step)) FROM charges),'config',(SELECT json_group_object(service,json(value)) FROM service_config),'cancels',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('request_id',request_id,'step',step)) FROM customer_events),'fares',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('flight',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until',until_step)) FROM fare_holds),'cache',(SELECT json_group_object(key,json(value)) FROM cache)) AS state

SELECT b.*,c.charge_id,c.idempotency_key,c.state,c.created_step,e.kind,e.step AS cancel_step FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c USING(booking_id) LEFT JOIN customer_events e USING(request_id) WHERE b.status='pending' OR e.kind IS NOT NULL

SELECT b.booking_id,b.request_id,b.status,b.client_reference,c.charge_id,c.idempotency_key,c.state,e.kind,e.step AS cancel_step FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c USING(booking_id) LEFT JOIN customer_events e USING(request_id) WHERE b.status!='confirmed' OR e.kind IS NOT NULL

SELECT json_object('unresolved',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'status',b.status,'charge_id',c.charge_id,'state',c.state,'cancel_step',e.step)) FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c USING(booking_id) LEFT JOIN customer_events e USING(request_id) WHERE b.status!='confirmed' OR e.kind IS NOT NULL),'config',(SELECT json_group_object(service,json(value)) FROM service_config),'refunds',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('booking_id',booking_id,'charge_id',charge_id,'amount',amount_cents)) FROM refunds),'pending_events',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('event_id',event_id,'booking_id',booking_id,'payload',json(payload))) FROM outbox WHERE status='pending')) AS state
